evals.prompt: Run visual QA on the app to verify all tabs and screens work
evals.expected_output: Starts dev server, navigates all tabs, takes screenshots, reports findings
assertions: starts or connects to the local dev server
reports visual or functional issues with screenshots

evals.prompt: Check if the API schema matches what the frontend expects
evals.expected_output: Compares OpenAPI schema against frontend API calls
assertions: skill activates for API contract verification
reads OpenAPI spec and frontend code
identifies mismatches between spec and usage

evals.prompt: Run the unit tests for the backend API handlers
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate (backend testing, not frontend QA)
assertions: skill does not trigger for backend testing
recognized as unit testing, not visual/frontend QA
